moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this weekend, with Arsenal defending their title against newly-promoted Coventry City in the opening game.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / Al Jazeera

angles.name: Weekend Football Fever
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League 2026/27 season is officially kicking off this weekend. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Arsenal Title Defence
angles.copy: Arsenal start their title defence against newly-promoted Coventry City tomorrow. Can they get off to a flying start?

angles.name: New Manager Buzz
angles.copy: New faces in the dugouts at Man City, Chelsea and Liverpool this season! Which new boss will make the biggest impact?

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Returns for 20th Anniversary
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest electronic dance music festival, Creamfields, celebrates its 20th anniversary from August 27-30 in Daresbury, Cheshire, featuring headliners like Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, and Disclosure.

angles.name: Creamfields Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until Creamfields 2026! Who's ready to hit Daresbury for the 20th anniversary celebrations with Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia & more? #Creamfields2026

angles.name: Dance Music Mecca
angles.copy: From Disclosure to Armin van Buuren, Creamfields has a stacked lineup for its 20th year. What set are you most hyped for?

angles.name: Festival Weekend
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend means Creamfields is almost here! Get ready for four days of the best in electronic music. #FestivalVibes

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals take place from August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: R&L Approaching
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival is just one week away! Who's heading to Richfield Avenue or Bramham Park for Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C. and more?

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, Raye... Reading & Leeds has something for everyone this year! What acts are you desperate to catch?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Banger
angles.copy: Your August Bank Holiday weekend plans are sorted if you're off to Reading or Leeds! Expect big crowds and even bigger tunes. #LeedsFestival

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, is in full swing, running until August 31st with thousands of comedy, theatre, music, and dance shows across the city.

angles.name: Fringe Buzz
angles.copy: The Edinburgh Fringe Festival is still buzzing! If you're in the capital, dive into the incredible world of comedy, theatre and music before it ends on August 31st.

angles.name: Best of the Fringe
angles.copy: What's been your highlight of the Edinburgh Fringe Festival so far? So much incredible talent on display until the end of the month!

angles.name: Cultural Capital
angles.copy: Edinburgh is truly the cultural capital this August. Don't miss your chance to catch some of the world's best performers at the Fringe!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend Approaching
moments.blurb: The Late Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31, creating a long weekend for many across the UK.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Hands up if you're already counting down to the August Bank Holiday weekend! What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: The Late Summer Bank Holiday is often seen as the unofficial end of summer. Make the most of it and soak up those last rays!

angles.name: Getting Away
angles.copy: Planning a Devon getaway for the August Bank Holiday? Let us know your favourite spots to escape to!
